prayerExcerpt.en-US: My eyes have seen your salvation.

meta.face: Our Lady as in recurring-figures.md: a young woman of about eighteen with a delicate, softly OVAL face — a smooth high forehead, a fine straight nose with a narrow bridge, almond-shaped brown eyes under gently arched light-brown brows, lids lowered in a recollected gaze, softly rounded cheeks, a small rosy mouth, a small rounded chin; light-brown hair parted in the centre under a white inner veil and a blue mantle drawn over the head. The Christ Child as in recurring-figures.md: a plump, ROUND baby face with full rosy cheeks, a high rounded forehead, a small button nose, large clear brown eyes, a small rosy mouth, soft short golden-brown curls, a plain gold halo, about forty days old, eyes open, one small hand reaching up to Simeon's beard. St. Joseph as in recurring-figures.md: a man of about forty with a LONG OVAL face — a straight nose, gentle dark-brown eyes under level brows, a quiet mouth; full dark-brown curly hair to the nape and a short full dark-brown beard; green tunic and ochre-brown mantle. Simeon: a very old man of about eighty-five with a LONG, NARROW face — a high, lined forehead, a slightly hooked nose, deep-set eyes wet with joy under white brows, hollow cheeks over high cheekbones; a long, soft white beard that divides into two locks, and white hair falling to the shoulders, uncovered. Anna: a woman of about eighty-four with a small, HEART-SHAPED face tapering to a pointed chin — a fine thin nose, bright dark eyes deep in soft wrinkles, a small smiling mouth; grey hair hidden under her dark veil.
meta.basis: Luke 2:22-38 gives the scene: the offering of two turtledoves, Simeon taking the Child in his arms, and Anna the prophetess of eighty-four. Tradition paints Simeon as a very old man with a long white beard and Anna in a dark veil; Our Lady, the Child and Joseph keep their faces from recurring-figures.md. The card also serves the fourth Joyful Mystery.
